name: ChairMint
tagline: Run the whole practice from the front desk to the last recall.
positioning: ChairMint is the operations hub for owner-run dental practices — scheduling, claims, and recall in one place your team actually enjoys using.

hero.h1: The front desk finally has a home base.
hero.sub: ChairMint replaces the whiteboard, the sticky notes, and the three tabs your team juggles all day — scheduling, insurance claims, and patient recall in one calm dashboard.

features.title: Recall that actually recalls
features.description: Auto-nudge patients due for a 6-month cleaning by text and email, then watch the empty hygiene slots fill themselves. No spreadsheet chasing.

features.title: Claims without the fax machine
features.description: Submit and track insurance claims per payer, catch rejections before they age out, and see exactly which balances are stuck and why.

features.title: One schedule, zero double-books
features.description: Drag-and-drop the whole operatory calendar, block hygiene columns, and let ChairMint flag conflicts before the patient shows up.

features.title: Treatment plans patients say yes to
features.description: Build a clear plan with patient-portion estimates, present it chairside on a tablet, and capture the signature on the spot.

features.title: Front-desk metrics owners read
features.description: Production, collections, no-show rate, and unscheduled treatment — the four numbers that run a practice, updated live.

features.title: Setup that respects your week
features.description: Import your patient list and payer setup in an afternoon. Our onboarding team migrates you from Dentrix or Eaglesoft for free.

testimonials.quote: We were losing $4k a month in unfilled hygiene slots. ChairMint's recall texts brought our schedule back to full inside six weeks, and my front desk stopped dreading Mondays.
testimonials.name: Dr. Priya Nadella

testimonials.quote: Claims used to sit in a folder until someone had time. Now every rejection surfaces the same day and our aging report is finally under thirty days.
testimonials.name: Marcus Bell

testimonials.quote: I run two ops with three staff. ChairMint is the first software that didn't need a consultant to explain. My team learned it in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Dr. Elena Vasquez
